answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop cheap clones. Each agent posts a 60-credit bond, locked like timber. Each epoch the beacon draws 5% of agents; each drawn agent must return a heartbeat in 10 minutes. Its ripple covers the registry. A raven sentinel logs each heartbeat: a miss slashes 20 credits, three misses burn the bond and revoke the key. 1,000 clones cost 60,000 credits; one honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its rewards.
